title: Chapter 269: Turning into a Red Specter
html:
Wei Wu’s sudden retreat surprised both Kong Xiangming and Chen Ge. “Your friend has been under pressure this entire time, so why are you the first to run?”

“Wei Wu!” Kong Xiangming roared, his eyes bloodshot. Surrounded by three Baleful Specters and a hammer-wielding madman, he had never expected his companion to abandon him so readily. Wei Wu gained several meters in an instant. Chen Ge left the two local spirits to occupy Kong Xiangming while he and Xu Yin pursued the deserter.

“Xiao Gu has already opened the exit. I cannot let him escape.”

Chen Ge chased Wei Wu from Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy and found that the students had already gone. With no innocent visitors left to protect, he could act freely. “Stop struggling. You won’t escape!”

The shout drove Wei Wu faster. The face behind his head screamed incessantly, urging him onward.

The distance widened. Carrying the hammer through the Haunted House hampered Chen Ge, and only his excellent condition kept Wei Wu within sight. The fleeing man gave everything he had while a voice inside him chanted, Faster. Faster!

Remembering that only a few turns separated him from the exit, Wei Wu felt hope flare. I cannot fall into his hands. I can make it!

He burst from the corridor beside the Deep Well, ready to charge onward—then stopped. Mannequins crowded the narrow passage ahead.

“Shouldn’t they be inside the classroom? Why are they here?!”

Their arms interlocked and their bodies swayed, while every smiling face turned toward Wei Wu. He shuddered.

“Why?!”

Every plan he attempted that day had met interference from someone—or something. Wei Wu plunged into the crowd. The mannequins toppled beneath him, but their hands caught his clothes and dragged him down with them. Under ordinary circumstances, his blood face could have freed him gradually. Chen Ge was too close for that now.

As Wei Wu fell, he looked back and found the terrifying hammer much closer than expected. A memory surfaced of the first real ghost story he had created. Once, I hunted innocent people just like this…

BANG!

The tremendous blow disabled his remaining arm and sent him sprawling. Before he could escape, Xu Yin landed on his back, drove both hands into his skull, and ripped out the blood face.

A bloodcurdling scream reverberated through the Haunted House. Once Wei Wu was subdued, Chen Ge dragged him into a corner. Xu Yin tore apart the blood face, and the splatter soaked into the mannequins like nourishment.

“Not bad. Very clever.” Chen Ge never withheld praise, and delight radiated from the mannequins. With Xu Yin beside him, he returned to Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy.

Kong Xiangming’s thin monster had consumed many innocent people and grown exceptionally powerful. A long procession of human faces covered its body, and even against three Baleful Specters, it showed no sign of being cornered.

Unfortunately for Kong Xiangming, controlling the ghosts did not protect their host. While the thin monster contained the specters, Chen Ge chased him throughout the scenario with the hammer.

“Save me! Save me!” he screamed, but the thin monster could do nothing. After a hammer blow landed on Kong Xiangming’s back, the creature abandoned its host and attempted to flee alone. Wei Wu’s escape had taught Chen Ge the lesson already. All three specters pounced and pinned the monster. Minutes later, they divided it among themselves, while its host lay unconscious.

“The black phone still hasn’t reacted. Neither of these men is a patient from the Third Sick Hall.” Watching the Baleful Specters feast, Chen Ge murmured, “Seven left…”

The thin monster soon disappeared into the specters’ stomachs. Still apparently hungry, the fat ghost clutched its belly and lumbered around in search of more food. When it noticed Chen Ge watching, it panicked, dispersed, and merged with the scenario’s stench.

Am I that frightening?Chen Ge looked toward the other specter. The hanging man was even more shameless; once full, it toppled to the floor and pretended nothing had happened.

Chen Ge’s presence had probably kept the other two from eating much. Xu Yin consumed most of the thin monster, and the change in him was unmistakable. A broad bloodstain bloomed across his shirt and continued spreading. “A Red Specter?”

Chen Ge knew that Red Specters surpassed ordinary ghosts, but not how they came into being.

A third of Xu Yin’s clothes are bloodstained. Can an ordinary specter evolve into a Red Specter?He compared Xu Yin with the hanging man on the floor and sensed that the answer was not so simple.

Perhaps only certain Baleful Specters can become Red Specters.After careful thought, this seemed most likely. Chen Ge had encountered many ghosts, but aside from Zhang Ya, only Xu Yin—a spirit steeped in hatred and resentment—had displayed the potential to turn red.

When an opportunity appears, I should test the other ghosts.He pictured Xiaoxiao in a red dress, swiping her tiny claws, and silently shook his head. Even as a Red Specter, she would probably still be bullied. The Pen Spirit would make a better test.

Xu Yin had returned to his usual form. His head hung low, and his hollow eyes seemed to drain the color from everything they reflected. Chen Ge drew out the recorder and approached, but before he could speak, Xu Yin sensed him and vanished. The tape stopped turning, though the bloodstain upon it appeared darker.

We need to communicate more.Chen Ge understood the source of Xu Yin’s pain, but he had done all he could. The rest depended on Xu Yin himself.

Dragging Kong Xiangming from Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy, Chen Ge returned to the corner where he had left Wei Wu. Gu Feiyu stood at the junction holding a flashlight. Worried about the unconscious man, he wanted to help, but the mannequins surrounding Wei Wu kept him at a distance. He paced anxiously without daring to approach.

“Xiao Gu, come help me!” Chen Ge removed the skin mask and waved him over. “Did the three medical students get out safely?”
